name: remember
description: Save a note only when the speaker explicitly says to remember, keep, note, save, or store information for later. An ordinary stated fact is not a request and returns no call.

summary.description: The fact to remember, copied word for word without the remember request

subject.description: Main named subject copied word for word; include only when clearly stated

name: do
description: Add a task for the speaker to do. Use for a first-person future commitment or need, or a direct imperative. A dated task is still do. Negated, cancelled, completed, speculative, descriptive, and another person's actions return no call.

summary.description: The complete task phrase copied word for word, without I will, I need to, or please

action.description: Main action verb copied word for word

object.description: Thing acted on copied word for word; include only when stated

target.description: Recipient or person the action is directed to, copied word for word; include only when stated

deadline_text.description: Date or time phrase copied word for word; never resolve it; include only when stated

name: follow_up
description: Add one task for the speaker that is gated by if, when, once, after, receiving something, missing a response, or a future check. Also use for explicit follow up or check again tasks. Negated, completed, speculative, descriptive, and another person's actions return no call.

summary.description: The complete action after the condition, copied word for word

action.description: Main action verb or combined verb phrase copied word for word

object.description: Thing acted on copied word for word; include only when stated

target.description: Recipient or person the action is directed to, copied word for word; include only when stated

deadline_text.description: Date or time phrase copied word for word; never resolve it; include only when stated

trigger.description: The if, when, once, after, receipt, or missing-response condition copied word for word; include only when stated
